title: Customer Service
description: Questions about our men's and women's sport shoes or your order? We'll route you to the right team.

customizations.welcomeMessage: Hi! Welcome to our men's and women's sport shoe store. How can we help you today? Ask us about billing, sizing and fit, buying a pair, returns and exchanges, or shipping and delivery.

displayedMessages.shows: The team reply chosen by the Claude router (or the shoes-only notice when Check Shoes finds no shoe mention), prefixed with an apology when Analyze Sentiment rates the message Very Angry or Irritated/Frustrated
